# Ghareeb Fencing Solutions

> Fence installer in Toledo, Ohio. Family owned. Serves Northwest Ohio and Southeast Michigan.

## Contact
- Phone: (419) 214-2107
- Email: nick@ghareebfence.com
- Office: 5242 Tractor Rd Suite C, Toledo, OH 43612
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 8 am to 6 pm
- Website: https://ghareebfence.com/

## What we install
- Cedar and pressure-treated wood: dog-ear privacy, board-on-board, shadowbox, lattice top, cap and trim, horizontal, spaced picket, ranch rail
- Vinyl: privacy, semi-privacy, picket and ranch rail, in several colors
- Ornamental aluminum
- Chain link, galvanized and black, up to 6 ft
- Split rail
- Gates to match, and removal of an old fence

## Good to know
- Free on-site measure and written proposal
- 3-year workmanship warranty
- Licensed and insured
- Financing options
- Installs through the winter
